articles.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang: China Is 'Not Our Enemy,' US Chip Policy a 'Mistake'
articles.description: In an interview filmed on October 14, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defended engaging with China and criticized US chip restrictions. He has since acknowledged having an affair, and US intelligence officials reportedly suspect the woman was recruited by Beijing to influence him. Nvidia’s board is now investigating, and Huang said he would "cooperate fully." He spoke with Bloomberg’s Emily Chang for an upcoming episode of The Circuit. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Voters Put the AI Data Center Boom on Notice
articles.description: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News tech reporter Brody Ford explains how voter backlash against data centers could disrupt the rapid buildout of infrastructure powering the AI boom. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ford discusses the risks for heavily indebted AI companies and whether tougher promises from newly elected officials will translate into meaningful restrictions on development. (Source: Bloomberg)
